description: This file implements the USBMassStorage plugin for WPEFramework, including initialization, deinitialization, notification handling for device mount/unmount events, and error handling.

classes.name: USBMassStorage
classes.description: Main class implementing the USB mass storage plugin, managing device events, initialization, and cleanup.

classes.name: USBMassStorage::Notification
classes.description: Nested class handling device mount/unmount notifications and connection deactivation events.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service, sets up device interface and notifications.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and releases interfaces.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Information
methods.description: Returns a string describing the plugin's purpose.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Notification::Activated
methods.description: Handles activation of a remote connection (empty implementation).

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Notification::Deactivated
methods.description: Handles deactivation of a remote connection.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Notification::OnDeviceMounted
methods.description: Handles device mounted events, notifying the system.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Notification::OnDeviceUnmounted
methods.description: Handles device unmounted events, notifying the system.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::OnJSONRPCError
methods.description: Handles JSON RPC errors, translating error codes to messages.
